Generated Narrative: CodeSystem molecular-biomarker-ontology-cs

This case-sensitive code system http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/genomics-reporting/CodeSystem/molecular-biomarker-ontology-cs defines the following codes in a Is-A hierarchy:

LvlCodeDisplayDefinition
1_physiologyBiomarkerCategory Molecular biomarker physiologic role categoryA category based on the normal bodily function of the biomarker.
2  antibody antibody categoryMolecular biomarker physiologic role is an antibody.
2  antgen antigen categoryMolecular biomarker physiologic role is an antigen.
2  cellReceptor cell receptor categoryMolecular biomarker physiologic role is a cell receptor.
2  cellReceptorLigand cell receptor ligand categoryMolecular biomarker physiologic role is a cell receptor ligand.
1_moleculeTypeBiomarkerCategory Molecular biomarker molecular type categoryA category based on the type of biomarker molecule.
2  carbohydrate carbohydrate categoryMolecular biomarker molecule type is a carbohydrate.
2  lipid lipid categoryMolecular biomarker molecule type is a lipid.
2  nucleicAcid nucleic acid categoryMolecular biomarker molecule type is a nucleic acid.
2  protein protein categoryMolecular biomarker molecule type is a protein. Includes single or multi-subunit proteins with or without post-translational modifications.
1_methodBiomarkerCategory Molecular biomarker method type categoryA category based on the measurement ascertainment method of the biomarker. (Methods are drawn from LOINC (https://loinc.org/kb/users-guide/major-parts-of-a-loinc-term/#type-of-method-6th-part) and NCBI Genetic Testing Registry (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gtr/)).
2  enzymeAssay enzyme assay categoryMolecular biomarker method is enzyme assay.
2  flowCytometry flow cytometry categoryMolecular biomarker method is flow cytometry.
2  immuneStain immune stain categoryMolecular biomarker method is immune stain.
2  immunoassay immunoassay categoryMolecular biomarker method is immunoassay.
2  methylationAnalysis methylation analysis categoryMolecular biomarker method is methylation analysis.
2  molgen molecular sequence adjacent categoryMolecular biomarker method is molecular sequence adjacent observation.

name: MolecularBiomarkerOntologyCS
title: Molecular Biomarker Ontology Codes
description: This (experimental) code system provides for a draft categorization of biomarkers along several axes. Based on ballot feedback, the committee anticipates significant revisions.
